verdict.rationale: Shortwave's own docs describe automations that act without user prompting: triggers that draft replies when emails arrive, add comments and organize threads into todos, plus plain-English AI filters that automatically label, star and archive. The evidence is only brief marketing and changelog lines, with no detail on how autonomous background execution works, and some autonomous action comes through a separate integration (Tasklet). Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of trigger and automation configuration and limits, clarity on server-side background execution versus in-app execution, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Set up triggers to draft replies when emails arrive, add comments for your team, organize threads into todos, and connect to 3,000+ other apps.
Take control of your inbox with custom AI filters. Automatically label, star, archive, and more with scripts you write in plain English.
Shortwave now integrates with Tasklet to take action on your emails automatically.
